newsitem.title: USA: Standex sees flat Q4 profit, yr below views.
newsitem.headline: Standex sees flat Q4 profit, yr below views.

text.p: Standex International Corp said on Wednesday that it expects that its fourth quarter profit levels will be similar to the $0.49 a share reported in the year ago quarter.

Standex's results for the year ended June 1997 will not reach the levels that it had previously anticipated. In the prior fiscal year, the company had reported earnings of $2.21 a share on sales of $562.7 million.
First Call's consensus earnings estimates for the company were $0.49 a share for the fourth quarter and $2.02 for the year.

Edward Trainor, president and chief executive officer, said in a statement, "We have experienced difficulties in assimilating some recent acquisitions and incurred greater than expected restructuring charges at one division."
Also, some units are facing increasing competitive pricing pressure.
However, Standex's backlogs continue higher than last year at this time and the company is continuing to work closely with operating divisions to reduce costs, the company said.
